name: Love Chaser
source:
Adventure game to investigate the case of fake kidnapping to stop political marriage that developed into a real abduction.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
为逃避政治联姻而策划的假绑架，竟演变成真正的绑架案。玩家需要调查事件并救出当事人。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
